skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Autumn Shadow
skins.content: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Autumn Shadow. Clothes Figurino made himself from Yanese materials after talking to local craftsmen. The craftsmen sent him some shadow puppets, and ever since, the silhouette of the one he cares for appears in the window.
skins.quote: Shadows of flitting feathers wi' golden osmanthus pluck'd, attend the gentleman who, with scissors sharp, shapes fair autumns' husks.
